recognize_zh: 周邊血中單一顆比小淋巴球大的異型淋巴樣細胞，圓核染色質粗而成塊、細胞質為一圈淡藍色；圖中顆粒不易辨識，單看形態不具專一性，需結合 CD56+ 流式與臨床才能歸為侵襲性 NK 細胞白血病。
features: Single atypical lymphoid cell larger than a small lymphocyte
Round nucleus with coarse, clumped chromatin; nucleolus not evident
Thin to moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm; fine azurophilic granules not clearly resolved in this image
Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional elliptocytes/teardrop-like forms
Scattered small dark particles likely representing platelets or stain precipitate
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single large atypical lymphoid cell with a round nucleus, coarse clumped chromatin, no conspicuous nucleolus and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm; cytoplasmic granules are subtle and not clearly resolved at this resolution. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. A single cell of this type is not diagnostic by morphology. In the setting of flow cytometry showing surface CD3-negative, CD56-positive NK cells, EBV positivity and a fulminant clinical course, the findings are consistent with circulating cells of aggressive NK-cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Reactive LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with distinct azurophilic granules and a heterogeneous, non-clonal phenotype.
T-LGL cells are small to intermediate mature granular lymphocytes that are surface CD3+/CD8+/CD57+ with an indolent course.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cell (e.g. DLBCL or mantle cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: B-cell lymphoma cells express CD19/CD20 and lack NK markers.
Reactive lymphocytes show a spectrum of forms with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, and resolve with infection.
